rules.source: Shillinq VAT return check: every VAT line has a box (REQ-TVRB-001)
rules.statement: Every posted ledger line of the period on a VAT account, or carrying VAT, has a VAT return box.

rules.source: Shillinq VAT return check: posted VAT equals base times rate (REQ-TVRB-001)
rules.statement: The VAT posted for each tariff of a transaction equals its base times the tariff's rate, within one cent.

rules.source: Shillinq VAT return check: VAT accounts agree with the return (REQ-TVRB-001)
rules.statement: The period movement of the output VAT account equals the VAT the return declares as owed, and that of the input VAT account equals its input tax.

rules.source: Shillinq VAT return check: nothing unposted in the period (REQ-TVRB-001)
rules.statement: No draft or unposted invoice or journal entry is dated in the period of the return.

rules.source: Shillinq VAT return check: the previous return is filed (REQ-TVRB-001)
rules.statement: The return of the previous period is submitted before this one, unless this is the administration's first return.

rules.source: Shillinq VAT return check: reverse-charge VAT owed and deducted (REQ-TVRB-001)
rules.statement: A reverse-charged purchase declares its VAT both as owed in the box of its tariff and as deductible in 5b, for the same amount.
